'''''Sunnida''''' was a flight group of three [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] that were operated by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].

==Known ships==
*[[Sunnida 1]]
*[[Sunnida 2]]
*[[Sunnida 3]]

==History==
{{Quote|Gamma 1 has detected illicit narcotics aboard FRT Sunnida 1|Imperial|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter" />}}
The freighters ''Sunnida'' were three [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] escorted by a pair of [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttles]], ''[[Yagmar]]'', operated by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The freighters were inspected by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] to find that ''[[Sunnida 1]]'' was carrying [[Narcotic incense|narcotics]], which were illegal, while ''[[Sunnida 2]]'' and ''[[Sunnida 3|3]]'' carried [[Stimstick/Legends|stimsticks]].

Upon discovering this, the TIE Interceptor was ordered to help a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transport]] [[Epsilon 2]] capture the freighter by draining the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] so that the [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] could disable it. The shuttles ''Yagmar'' attempted to stop the operation but were shot down, and the freighter was captured and taken to an Imperial shipyard.

==Legacy==
{{Quote|Good work, Gamma 1! You've helped stop a smuggling operation. The freighter will be taken to an Imperial storage yard.|Imperial officer|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter" />}}
The event surrounding the ships was recreated as a training mission in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot]]s. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] took this training mission.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Very good! You've helped stop a spying operation. The freighter will be taken to an Alliance storage yard.|Instructor|<ref name="xwing">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''</ref>}}
''Sunnida'' was created for the [[1994]] video game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] and appears in the first TIE Interceptor training mission, "Threat Display." The freighter must be disabled and captured to complete the "Secondary" mission objectives.

The freighters also appear in the [[1997]] video game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'', in the training mission inspection, in which the player can be either Alliance or Imperial and can have any craft of their choice. ''Sunnida'' and ''Yagmar'' play the same roles in both versions, but if the player takes the Alliance version, ''Sunnida 1'' carries [[Imperial Spy|Imperial spies]], while the rest carry [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] and the shuttles carry Imperials. The ships can be destroyed for points.
